BiblicalUsage: This word is disease and rust, the scum that will not leave the pot. Jerusalem is the bloody city, the pot whose scum is in it and will not come out, and the pot is set empty on the coals so the filthiness may be molten and the scum consumed.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the rust in the pot is the sin that will not wash out, and God sets the empty pot on the fire to burn it away.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
